MECHANISM: Cross-head twenty-third-distance bias tying

HYPOTHESIS: Sharing both heads’ twenty-third-farthest attention bias will reduce the model from 1,107 to 1,106 parameters while maintaining at least 99% accuracy, because all nine adjacent ties through the twenty-second-farthest distance succeeded and this preserves every routing distance.

INTENDED_EDIT: Shorten the independent per-head relative-bias core by one distance and reconstruct the twenty-third-farthest bias from one shared learned scalar.

EVIDENCE: The twenty-second-farthest tie achieved 99.91% accuracy with 1,107 parameters; prior twenty-third-distance attempts were unverifiable or reproduced the unchanged implementation, providing no negative accuracy evidence against the adjacent tie.
